cohort: 100 pregnant women aged 20-45 enrolled in antenatal care at Nishter Hospital in Multan, with 50 diagnosed with PCOS and 50 controls.
finding: PCOS was associated with higher rates of spontaneous abortion, GDM, and preterm birth, although only the difference in preterm birth approached statistical significance (p=0.07).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in women with PCOS (48%) compared to controls (22%).
